stepTitle: What is the empirical risk of the model on the above dataset?
stepBody: We train the model $$\widehat{\text{self\_rating}} $$=$$ \hat{\theta}_0 + \hat{\theta}_1 $$\times$$ (\text{critic\_1})**2$$ with optimal parameters $$\hat{\theta}_0 $$=$$ $$2$$ and $$\hat{\theta}_1 $$=$$ $$1$$, $$and$$ $$evaluate$$ $$it$$ $$on$$ $$the$$ $$dataset$$ $$\begin{array}{c|cc$$} $$&$$ \text{critic\_1} $$&$$ \text{self\_rating} $$\\$$ $$\hline$$ $$\text{A$$} $$&$$ $$2$$ $$&$$ $$3$$ $$\\$$ $$\text{B$$} $$&$$ $$1$$ $$&$$ $$2$$ $$\\$$ $$\text{C$$} $$&$$ $$2$$ $$&$$ $$1$$ $$\end{array}$$. $$ \cup se$$ $$ridge$$ $$regression$$ $$with$$ $$hyper-parameter$$ $$\lambda$$ $$=$$ $$\frac{1}{3}$$ (the intercept is not regularized).
